direction: Quasi-1D nozzle, gas-pipeline and valve-closure transients
validated_status: Migration hypothesis; closest to validated Euler family
why_the_model_may_help: Normal shocks and contact waves need conservation, positivity and compact shock capture on coarse meshes
required_extensions: Geometric-area/friction source terms; well-balanced source discretization; inlet/outlet characteristic boundaries
go_no_go_experiment: Parameterized nozzle area/back-pressure sweep; require >=1.2x error gain over FNO and no worse conservation than HLLC at equal cells

direction: LWR traffic queues and signalized-road shock waves
validated_status: Migration hypothesis; strong literature precedent for neural FV
why_the_model_may_help: Queue fronts are entropy shocks of a scalar conservation law; fast repeated scenarios benefit from learned conservative local updates
required_extensions: Replace Euler flux by a calibrated fundamental diagram; network junction and signal boundary conditions; density bounds
go_no_go_experiment: Ring-road and signal corridor with unseen queue counts; compare shock location, vehicle conservation and online latency

direction: Shallow-water dam break, levee breach and rapid flood routing
validated_status: Migration hypothesis; high value but 2D extension required
why_the_model_may_help: Wet/dry fronts and hydraulic jumps directly reward positivity and conservative subcell resolution
required_extensions: 2D unstructured/Cartesian reconstruction; well-balanced bed-slope source; wet/dry positivity; rainfall/friction terms
go_no_go_experiment: 1D wet-bed/dry-bed dam break first, then 2D breach; require zero negative depth and mass-balance tolerance

direction: Reactive Euler detonation and blast-wave propagation
why_the_model_may_help: Very thin shocks and coarse-grid subcell limiting match the architecture's intended advantage
required_extensions: Species and reaction-energy equations; stiff chemistry integrator; entropy-stable reactive flux; multidimensional AMR
strong_comparators: Reactive WENO, ADER-DG plus a-posteriori subcell WENO, AMR HLLC
go_no_go_experiment: Start with 1D ZND/CJ detonation; reject deployment if wave speed or heat-release conservation fails
